title: SF1596 (2025-2026 Regular): Sale or transfer of a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon prohibition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-02-17; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/1596/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced text. Section 1 widens the assault-weapon definition by striking the sporting-purposes exception. Appropriation amounts are blank. Struck text left out of quotes. Version read: introduced text (as filed). No passage vote is recorded for this bill.

operative_text:
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7145, subd. 2): It is unlawful for a person to transfer a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.7145, subd. 4): A person who violates subdivision 2 is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $25,000, or both.
Section 3 (buyback program, subd. 1): The commissioner of public safety shall establish a statewide buyback program to purchase semiautomatic military-style assault weapons.
